# orca task

Every `orca task` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca task show <group> <task>`

one task of a group and its runs

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix

## `orca task retry <group> <task>`

start again a task whose current run failed (the run read now is the one retried)

- What it does: sends control verb `retry-task`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix

## `orca task continue <group> <task>`

continue a task's current run from its newest complete checkpoint

- What it does: sends control verb `continue-task`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix

## `orca task set-loop <group> <task> --file <file>`

set a task's loop plan from a JSON file {plan,inputs,work,workProvenance?,skills?}

- What it does: sends control verb `set-task-loop`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix
- `--file <file>` (required): the loop JSON

## `orca task set-labels <group> <task> [--label <label>] [--clear]`

set a task's labels (--label repeatable), or --clear back to the plan's

- What it does: sends control verb `set-task-labels`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix
- `--label <label>` (repeatable): a label
- `--clear`: drop the operator's labels

## `orca task verify-saved-result <group> <task>`

verify the current run's saved result instead of re-running (after run eligibility says eligible)

- What it does: sends control verb `verify-saved-result`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix

## `orca task settle-usage <group> <task> --acknowledge <acknowledge>`

settle a run's unknown usage (cannot be undone)

- What it does: sends control verb `settle-unknown-usage`.
- Who may: a person: needs a person token over the socket (`orca login`, then `--as-person`).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `<task>`: a task id or a unique prefix
- `--acknowledge <acknowledge>` (required): charge-remaining-grant|release-unmetered
